## Structure and components

- [statement] Total VRAM is weights plus KV cache plus runtime overhead. KV bytes per token = 2 x attention layers x KV heads x head dim x bytes per element (f16 2, q8_0 1.06, q4_0 0.56). Example: Llama 3.1 8B uses 128 KiB per token, about 4.3 GB at 32K context. Runtime overhead is about 0.7 GB at short context, paid per GPU. (medium confidence) — https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://docs.ollama.com/faq
- [statement] On a 24 GB card the auto-sized 32k default context for a 32B Q4 model can push total memory past VRAM, spilling layers to CPU and cutting throughput to about a tenth. Fix: cap OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH or num_ctx. (low confidence) — https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant
- [statement] For GPU inference a model should fit fully in VRAM; ollama ps shows the Processor column (100% GPU, 100% CPU, or a CPU/GPU split such as 48%/52%). A split means some layers run on CPU from system RAM and is much slower. (high confidence) — https://docs.ollama.com/faq · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/

## How it works

- [statement] Ollama's default context length depends on detected VRAM: under 24 GiB gives 4k, 24-48 GiB gives 32k, 48 GiB or more gives 256k. Larger context raises memory use; OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the server process or the app slider overrides it. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/context-length · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Q4_K_M file sizes: Llama 3.1 8B about 4.9 GB, Qwen3 32B about 19.8-20 GB, Llama 3.3 70B about 42.5-43 GB. Q8_0 of Llama 3.1 8B is about 8.5 GB, roughly double Q4_K_M, and Q6_K is about 6.6 GB. (high confidence) — https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/
- [statement] Tier guide at Q4_K_M, 8K context, one request: 7-8B needs about 6-7 GB VRAM (8 GB card), 12-14B about 10-12 GB (16 GB card), 20-32B about 19-24 GB (24 GB card with short context), 70-72B about 47-52 GB (48 GB tight, 80 GB comfortable). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-10) — https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/
- [statement] CPU-only inference holds the model in system RAM. Guidance: about 16 GB RAM for a 4.9 GB 8B Q4 model, 32 GB as headroom for a ~20 GB model paired with an 8 GB GPU. Apple Silicon uses unified memory; about 23-25 GB is usable by Ollama on a 32 GB Mac. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-15) — https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] A forum-reported mismatch (phi4-mini showing about 8.9 GB in Ollama against 2.5 GB in a calculator) was explained as weights-only versus weights plus context; calculators that omit context and buffers underestimate real use. (low confidence) — https://forum.level1techs.com/t/ollama-confusion-about-model-size/254525 · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Weight bytes per parameter (Llama 3.3 70B): BF16 2.00, Q8_0 1.06, Q5_K_M 0.71, Q4_K_M 0.60, Q4_0 0.57, IQ4_XS 0.54. Pre-quantized models such as gpt-oss-120b (MXFP4) break this rate, so read the file size instead. (medium confidence) — https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/ · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://hostinger.com/tutorials/ollama-gpu-requirements/
- [statement] Required memory scales with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL x context length: a 2K context with 4 parallel requests becomes an 8K context allocation. Flash attention reduces memory as context grows; quantized KV cache needs flash attention (q8_0 about 1/2 of f16, q4_0 about 1/4). (high confidence) — https://docs.ollama.com/faq · keywords: Ollama hardware sizing: RAM and VRAM requirements by model and quant · also: https://computingforgeeks.com/how-much-vram-to-run-llm/
